headerDisplay:
A Homebridge plugin for controlling MagicHome single color LED strips through HomeKit.

**Features:**
• HomeKit integration for MagicHome LED devices
• Brightness control via red channel mapping
• Automatic MAC to IP address resolution
• Real-time status polling

For support and documentation, visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/fbernaly/homebridge-magichome-led-controller).
footerDisplay: Having issues? Check the [troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/fbernaly/homebridge-magichome-led-controller#troubleshooting) or open an issue on GitHub.

layout.helpvalue:
💡 LED Device Configuration

Add your MagicHome LED devices below. You can use either IP addresses or MAC addresses.

Supported Address Formats:
  • IP Address: 192.168.1.90
  • MAC (colons): AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF
  • MAC (hyphens): AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF
  • MAC (no separators): AABBCCDDEEFF

✅ Configuration Tips

  • Ensure your MagicHome devices are powered on and connected to WiFi
  • For MAC addresses, the device must be on the same network as Homebridge
  • Use descriptive names that will make sense in the Apple Home app
  • Lower polling intervals provide faster updates but use more network resources
